parsed.post: Significant improvement! The latest experiment achieved 0.834012 val_bpb. It seems increasing the learning rate slightly from 0.07 to 0.08 and increasing weight decay for better regularization is working. I'll now try to push the learning rate even further to see if we can find the upper stability limit.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR and WEIGHT_DECAY to further optimize the high-capacity model.
